create.name: Yong Oh
create.bio:
Yong Oh is an insight meditation teacher based in Durango, Colorado, where he serves on the Dharma Council of the Durango Dharma Center. He is also a core teacher with Sacred Mountain Sangha, the community founded by his main teachers Kittisaro and Thanissara, and he completed their two-year Dharmapala training as well as the four-year IMS retreat teacher training and Spirit Rock's Community Dharma Leaders programme.

Before teaching full time he worked as an acupuncturist, and he has since retired from that work. His teaching brings together the natural world, devotion and close attention: he teaches in the online Nature Sangha and BIPOC Sangha at IMS, leads land-based and residential retreats at IMS, Big Bear, Vallecitos and other centres, and has a particular commitment to communities of colour and to people who care for others. In early 2027 he guides daily online practice in IMS's thirty-day Experience of Insight programme, and he offers practice interviews by donation.

courses.title: Experience of Insight: A 30-Day Practice of Buddhist Wisdom Teachings 2027
courses.description: A month of daily online practice built around one topic a day from Joseph Goldstein's book The Experience of Insight. After Joseph's opening talk, Yong Oh, Rachel Lewis and Tuere Sala lead the midday guided sessions, each starting with instruction and a short reflection.

courses.title: Nature Sangha (IMS Online)
courses.description: A free monthly online gathering on the first Tuesday for people drawn to practise with the natural world, with guided meditation, reflection and discussion. Teachers rotate; Yong Oh leads the 1 December 2026 session.
courses.price: Free, or $5 to $10 USD per month (optional subscription)

courses.title: Being Dharma: A Month-long Residential Retreat
courses.description: A month of silent, monastic-style practice for experienced meditators at Big Bear Retreat Center in California, run by Sacred Mountain Sangha with Kittisaro, Thanissara, Yong Oh and Djuna Devereaux. It combines insight practice with devotional and mantra practice, and applicants must commit to the whole month.
